title: Ontology Version and Source Schema
description: A schema for the set of valid ontology reference files mapping to a CZ CellXGene Dataset Schema Versions

^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+(-.+)?$.description: The version of CellxGene schema that maps to this set of ontology versions

deprecated_on.description: The date this version was deprecated. The format of the date is YYYY-MM-DD. If this is the current verison then this field will be empty.

version.description: version of ontology canonical to this data release, as defined in its source repo

source.description: Source to find and download canonical ontology version for this data release

filename.description: name of ontology file used to build generated artifacts for this ontology data release

additional_ontologies.description: List of additional term id prefixes to extracted from the source ontology file.

cross_ontology_mapping.description: name of SSSOM file mapping this ontology's terms to cross-species equivalent ontology terms.

map_to.description: List of ontologies to map equivalent terms to this ontology

url.description: Direct download URL for the ontology file. When present, overrides the URL constructed from source+version+filename. Used for ontologies whose distribution does not follow the {source}/{version}/{filename} path convention.

format.description: File format of the ontology source. Defaults to 'owl' when absent. 'owl.gz' is a gzip-compressed OWL file decompressed before parsing. 'xml.gz' is a gzip-compressed XML file kept compressed and parsed with a streaming parser. 'fasta.gz' is a gzip-compressed FASTA file parsed for accession and entry name (e.g. UniProt Swiss-Prot).

version_uri.description: URI that resolves to the version of the ontology. The resolved version will be used to verify the version of the download ontology file, and backfill the version in ontology_info.json if not provided.

ancestor_relations.description: Names of object properties to follow as hierarchy edges when computing ancestors, in addition to rdfs:subClassOf. Defaults to ["BFO_0000050"] (part_of). Ontologies that declare no is_a hierarchy of their own name the relation that acts as one, e.g. Cellosaurus uses "derived_from".

synonym_properties.description: oboInOwl synonym annotation properties to collect in addition to hasExactSynonym, e.g. ["hasRelatedSynonym"] for ontologies that only declare RELATED-scope synonyms.

id_separator.description: Character that separates the ontology prefix from the identifier in CURIEs. The default is ':' (colon).
